baseline.primary_change: New daily input and next-session OPEN/CLOSE prediction protocol; Context observed only.

final_sha_binding: COMMIT_CONTAINING_THIS_RECORD; exact SHA and file hashes in private final-delivery-attestation.json after commit

protocol.acceptance: Interpretation and sample adequacy only; never automatic model promotion, tuning, Provider qualification, trading or Alpha claim
protocol.cohort: Every canonical target session from first eligibility onward, original published roster; identical session duplicates fail closed; date filters are descriptive views only
protocol.economic_policy: NOT_ESTIMABLE without frozen executable holdings/turnover/cost/slippage/tradability/capacity/T+1 assumptions; independent episode diagnostics are not account P&L

formula_contract.aggregation: equal-weight session IC summaries; pooled errors separately stock-observation weighted; sample std n-1; ICIR mean/std unannualized; SE std/sqrt(session count) descriptive only, independence unproven, no inferential CI
formula_contract.calibration: OLS canonical label on forecast with intercept on exact common population; zero forecast variance unavailable
formula_contract.direction: sign(forecast)==sign(label); exact zero is flat, never probability
formula_contract.rank_ic: Spearman with average ties; at least 3 finite common pairs; zero variance unavailable
formula_contract.rank_stability: adjacent canonical session common instrument Spearman, no bridging unavailable session; exact overlap/union counts
formula_contract.ranking: descending frozen forecast, deterministic commitment-id ties; equal-weight top/bottom K; disjoint tails; quantile tails floor(n/5); membership never uses label

protocol.historic_session_policy: Before first eligibility only POST_HOC_DESCRIPTIVE; original Evaluation metric bytes untouched
protocol.missingness_policy: Retain complete sampled/commitment roster; pair requires complete canonical finite label and both finite forecasts and temporal validity; UNKNOWN availability excluded; finality UNKNOWN retained with explicit exploratory qualifier; no imputation
protocol.persistence: PACKAGED_IMMUTABLE_SOURCE_RESOURCE; original canonical observations remain PostgreSQL/Artifact owned; no second research truth table
protocol.population: ALL_PUBLISHED_COMMITMENTS_OF_ALL_DAILY_REQUESTS_FOR_EXACT_MODEL_USE_TARGET; preserve sampled ineligible unavailable failed sessions; no performance selection
protocol.predecessor_policy: v1 has incomplete exact population binding and cannot establish a validity baseline; its observations are preserved as PREDECESSOR_PROTOCOL_DESCRIPTIVE and never promoted into v2
protocol.reason: Pre-outcome correctness review closes v1 missing exact Candidate/Eligibility/population identity binding; formulas, model and thresholds unchanged. v1 preserved as incomplete descriptive predecessor.
protocol.revision_policy: Append new immutable version and predecessor SHA, new actual declaration time and later first eligible future session; no old cohort relabeling

walk_forward.model_binding: IMMUTABLE_VERSION_PER_FOLD; no training in this protocol
walk_forward.pit_cutoff: every fit/validation source known at or before fold cutoff; OOS labels cannot feed same-generation features; existing daily DISCOVERY partitions remain DISCOVERY

reconstruct: Use the installed analysis wheel with read-only diagnostics for the original deployment; research daily observations / research validity daily reload exact canonical frozen plans, artifacts and Evaluation acquisitions. Full raw output is hash-bound above; never reacquire labels.

service_continuity.causality_limit: Historical deadline/statement timeout not reproduced in interactive profiling; exact expensive stages identified, host/QoS contribution unproven

policy.model_binding: IMMUTABLE_VERSION_PER_FOLD; no training in this protocol
policy.pit_cutoff: every fit/validation source known at or before fold cutoff; OOS labels cannot feed same-generation features; existing daily DISCOVERY partitions remain DISCOVERY
